generated_by: model/gen_tables.py; every value below is re-verified against the sources listed in input-verified.json before any CSV is written (0 anchor mismatches required)

units.clock: Hz unless the key ends in _mhz

device.label: device_totals=measured(docs/DDR + TD report row names); 270/210 are project gates, not hard limits

labels.raw_slot_bytes: derived ceil(G/4)*32 (20B/32B; 1.6x) - this run's adopted main layout

comp.label: measured (b6 independent rerun, cycles exact; rate=derived from bytes*clock/cycles)

rand.label: measured (b6 manifest/independent report; stored fallback, not worst case)

full_grad.label: measured (b6 P1 STAT: 1080p full frame, read_words=129600 proves the 20B/32B RAW slot geometry; .dec is the TB decimal text capture, 40076 lines = 180425 B file, NOT the payload size)

overhead.label: assumed (6421414-5995029.375; only proven on full_grad content; affine model for other geometry)

single_chain_b10_r1_routed.label: measured (b10 r1 routed; P1 round1 PASS)

dual_marginal.label: derived (P1 manifest 228531e7...bdd0; second core u_core + second bridge + second stream fabric; shared MCU/DDR PHY)

dual_conservative.label: derived upper bound (full second chain replicated; 85 DRAMHARDCON counted once; includes 2x15 CWC debug ERAM)

dual_ddr_variant.label: assumed variant (second DDR port/controller -> +85); not the default architecture

second_full_csi.label: measured + assumed (routed has ONLY u_csi_a; if a full second CSI RX is required: +773/340/1474/0; ERAM/fit unchanged)

ddr.layout_main: 20B_payload_per_32B_word (b10/b11 slot; this run's frozen design guide 5.1)
ddr.layout_tight_variant: packed 1.0x (20261025-180900 T08/T10 contract; variant only, not main)
ddr.label: peak = theoretical x32 1600 MT/s; not measured, excludes refresh/arbitration/bank switching

timing.single_core_proven_basis: b6 routed +0.119/0; b10 r1 routed +0.103/0 at clk_a1 187.5 MHz
timing.label: measured at 187.5 MHz only; 200 MHz and dual-core timing unproven

packing.label: frozen; RAW12 3,110,400 B and 1.0x slots are negative controls

labels_summary.measured: values read from b6/b10 routed reports, b6 STAT, or P1 frozen artifacts
labels_summary.derived: computed from measured values by the formulas in model/calc.py
labels_summary.assumed: model assumptions (overhead constancy, slice scaling, shared PHY, CSI delta)
labels_summary.unproven: no current evidence (dual-core Routed, DDR sustained, natural-image content, 200 MHz)
